# ============================================================================
#  IntegratedStorage - JakeSnowy Fork v4.1.2-audited (Zero-Config Default)
#  GitHub: https://github.com/Jakesnowy/sharing-base-resources
#  Base: Sarfflow's IntegratedStorageCpp v4.1.2 with P0 Critical Fixes
# ============================================================================

# [IMPORTANT] This fork includes ALL THREE P0 critical fixes that work
#             independently of external communication channel:
# - P0-a: hkEnterCamp local player filter (prevents flickering from remote events)
# - P0-b: Camp lookup cache via g_campIdToCamp (eliminates FindAllOf blocking lag)  
# - P0-c: Food box exclusion from storage cross-registration (fixes food consumption)
# These fixes provide major stability improvements regardless of channel mode.

# ============================================================================
#  DEPLOYMENT MODE - Zero-Config Default for Easy Deployment!
# ============================================================================
#
# This fork uses "Zero-Config Mode" by default:
#   ✅ Just copy DLL to all machines and play - no IP/port/firewall needed!
#   ✅ Works out-of-the-box with original RPC-based multiplayer
#   ✅ All P0 fixes still active for stability
#   ✅ Falls back to tested original behavior seamlessly
#
# For advanced users who want maximum stability (5+ players, dedicated servers):
#   - Edit this config and uncomment external_channel = true
#   - Configure IP addresses as described in USAGE_GUIDE.md
#
# ============================================================================

# verbose : Whether to output detailed [ISGATE] diagnostic logs in UE4SS.log.
#           Includes client menu open/request/reply tracking and server-side
#           per-chest + discovery tracking. Default true for debugging; set false
#           when stable. Options: true / false
verbose = true

# reconcile_interval_ms : (Server/host only) Frequency (ms) at which the server
#                         re-scans each guild's chests and reapplies cross-camp merges.
#                         Smaller values discover builds/destroys faster; larger values
#                         reduce background overhead. Minimum: 500.
#                         
# [RECOMMENDATION] With P0-b cache optimization, this is less critical:
#   - Single player / Small guild (<3 players): 8000ms (default)
#   - Medium guild (3-5 players): 15000ms
#   - Large guild (6+ players, many bases): 30000ms
reconcile_interval_ms = 8000

# isi_refresh_ms : Remote client refresh frequency. Kept for backward compatibility.
#                  Minimum: 200. Only used if external channel is disabled.
isi_refresh_ms = 1500

# ============================================================================
#  EXTERNAL TCP CHANNEL (Layer 1 - Optional Advanced Feature)
# ============================================================================
#
# This fork implements an external TCP channel that runs OUTSIDE the UE network
# driver on its own socket + thread. Benefits include:
#   - Zero reliable buffer saturation (prevents paralysis under load)
#   - Dedicated thread for network I/O (never blocks game thread)
#   - Optimized payload delivery with delta sync
#
# DEFAULT MODE: DISABLED for zero-config deployment
#   Most users won't need this - just copy DLL and play!
#   Original RPC-based multiplayer works fine with P0 fixes.
#
# ADVANCED MODE: Enable for large guilds, dedicated servers, or edge cases
#   Uncomment external_channel = true line below to enable
#   Then configure IP/port settings as needed (see USAGE_GUIDE.md)
# ============================================================================

# external_channel : Enable advanced TCP channel for maximum stability.
#                   DEFAULT: false (zero-config mode recommended)
#                   SET TO: true ONLY if you need advanced networking features
external_channel = false

# external_port : TCP channel port when enabled. Server listens here; clients connect here.
#                 All machines MUST use the same port if channel is enabled. Default: 27500. Range: 1-65535.
#                 Only applies when external_channel = true
external_port = 27500

# external_server_host : Server/Client IP or hostname to connect to.
#                       - With channel disabled (default): Ignored
#                       - With channel enabled: Fill with server's LAN IP on client machines only
#                       Examples: 192.168.1.100 or 10.0.0.5
#                 Only applies when external_channel = true
external_server_host =

# ============================================================================
#  LAYER 2: Delta Sync (Incremental Synchronization - Optional)
# ============================================================================
#
# Sends only changed items in steady state rather than full dumps, dramatically
# reducing bandwidth usage. This layer improves performance but is not required.
# Recommended to keep enabled if channel is active.
# ============================================================================

# channel_delta : Enable incremental updates (only changed items) instead of
#                 sending full dump every time. Reduces traffic significantly.
#                 Default: true
channel_delta = true

# channel_full_sync_interval : Interval (ms) to force a full resync when in delta mode.
#                              Acts as a recovery fallback for missed updates.
#                              Default: 1 hour. Minimum: 5000.
channel_full_sync_interval = 3600000

# ============================================================================
#  LAYER 3: Delay Reply (Reentrancy Protection - Optional Advanced)
# ============================================================================
#
# Delays reply to CH requests until on_update callback, providing additional
# protection against race conditions in edge cases. Keep disabled unless you
# experience specific edge-case issues.
# ============================================================================

# channel_delay_reply : Enable delayed reply to reentrancy protection.
#                       Default: false (disable for normal use)
channel_delay_reply = false

# ============================================================================
#  HOST-ONLY / DEVELOPER OPTION
# ============================================================================
# client_inject_enabled : Controls whether this machine performs client-side
#                         UI injection (minted slots) to show shared items.
#   - true (default): Normal behavior. REQUIRED on clients so they can see
#     the shared material pool in crafting/building UIs.
#   - false: Server-side cross-registration only. For developers testing whether
#     Palworld's native replication already shows shared items to unmodded
#     clients. End users should leave this enabled.
# IMPORTANT: This mod currently MUST be installed on every client for the
# shared pool to be visible. Host-only deployment is not yet supported.
client_inject_enabled = true
